craft_notes: Sthāyin: Courage of refuge (utsāha). Comma→dash (plumbing held, snicking released). Rejected: 'filches' verb for noun-stealing — kept snicks. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: What longings plumb her farthest marge — who snicks
glamour in one wink, keep us, Śiva, her.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yasyāḥ prāpyeta paryantaviśeṣaḥ kair manorathaiḥ māyām ekanimeṣeṇa muṣṇaṃs tāṃ pātu naḥ śivaḥ

reads_against.argmap: By which wishes could her end-distinction be reached. → May Śiva who steals māyā in a wink protect us.

l2.plain_english: What longings could sound her farthest shore — her who filches glamour in a single blink? Śiva, keep us.
